# Arctura

> Arctura publishes public records, practical tools, and clear boundaries
> for accountable agent infrastructure: decision support (Council), agent
> authorization (ARMS), and payment verification (Protocol). Each surface
> states its own current state and limits before its capabilities.

The canonical domain is arctura.org. arctura.network is the intended live
instance of the composed stack described below; treat any claim of that
split as provisional until stated on-site.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://arctura.org/): Public entry point. Working model: Record, Boundary, Tool, Review.
- [Field Index](https://arctura.org/field/): Directory of all public surfaces and their states.
- [ARMS](https://arctura.org/autonomous-resource-management/): Agent authorization — identity, mandate, permission, approval gate, receipt, audit. Conceptual.
- [Protocol](https://arctura.org/protocol/): Lightning-to-EVM payment verification. Early-stage, building. Not production-ready; no completed independent security review.
- [Arcturian Council](https://arctura.org/arcturian-council/): Disclosed AI decision-support service. Named functions (Pauli, Planck, Lorentz) are AI functions, not personnel. Not professional advice.
- [Collective](https://arctura.org/collective/): How Council, ARMS, and Protocol compose into one mandate record. Record format, not shipped infrastructure.
- [Case Studies](https://arctura.org/case-studies/): Evidence-oriented records.
- [Tools](https://arctura.org/tools/): Local-first browser utilities.
- [Support](https://arctura.org/support/): Contribution pathways.

## Archive (not current record)

- [Academy](https://arctura.org/academy/): Earlier learning tracks, retained as reference only.
- [Signal Archives](https://arctura.org/signal-archives/): Earlier long-form material, retained as reference only.
- [Guardian](https://arctura.org/guardian/) / [Arcturians](https://arctura.org/arcturians/): Source-note and identity-orientation content. Explicitly not membership, authority, or affiliation.

## Machine-Readable Infrastructure

- [Structured Data](https://arctura.org/schema.json): JSON-LD entity graph.
- [Sitemap](https://arctura.org/sitemap.xml): Live routes only.
- [Robots](https://arctura.org/robots.txt): Standard crawler access.

## Boundary

Arctura does not offer investment advice, payment guarantees, custody,
automated trading, or professional (medical/legal/tax) advice through any
surface described above. Protocol has not completed an independent
security review. ARMS and Collective describe conceptual/proposed systems,
not deployed authority.
